remarks: Tucked away on a picturesque cul-de-sac in trending East Norwalk, this charming 1939 Colonial offers the kind of warmth, character, and neighborhood feel that instantly feels like home. Surrounded by equally quaint residences and tree-lined streets, the setting is peaceful, welcoming, and wonderfully connected to everything East Norwalk has to offer. Inside and out, the home is filled with timeless charm and everyday comfort, creating an easy, inviting lifestyle that's becoming harder and harder to find. Centrally located yet tucked into a quiet neighborhood setting, this is the perfect blend of convenience, community, and classic New England appeal. Minutes to shops, restaurants, beaches, healthcare facilities, train and cultural attractions.
